title: NVIDIA Just Made 100+ AI Models Free 🤯 #nvidia #ai #aitools
description:
NVIDIA is giving developers access to 100+ powerful AI models in one place, making it easier to discover, test, and integrate different models into AI projects.

Through Build by NVIDIA, developers can explore models from leading AI ecosystems, generate API keys for supported models, and experiment with different AI capabilities without managing multiple platforms.

Whether you're building AI agents, coding tools, automation workflows, or experimenting with LLMs, this platform makes it easier to test different models and find the right one for your use case.

Would you try it? 👀
